about.title: SextoLugar
about.text:
A physical, psychological, immersive game. You don't "play" on the phone — you play at the table. The site is the soundtrack: it holds the mood, times the tension and prevents "shortcuts".

Recommended for 3 to 5 people. Open the entrance, read the ritual and start the first round. When the timer hits zero, it ends. Even if someone begs for "just one more".
